record.question: Raju and Ram are good boys. Identify the parts of speech of the underlined word 'and'.
record.explanation: Answer A: conjunction. And joins the names Raju and Ram; conjunction (A). Independent check: “And” joins the two coordinated noun phrases “Raju” and “Ram,” so it is a conjunction. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/conjunctions. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
